meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装好后,智能体能直接把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel:容器内会装好 Vercel 命令行工具,并自动注入访问令牌,后续执行部署、查看列表等操作无需用户再提供凭证。
howto.when: 当用户想让智能体把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel,或要求为智能体开启 Vercel 部署能力时。

say.text: 把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: 会执行 vercel 的生产部署命令。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署。
say.note: 会调用 vercel ls 显示部署记录。

say.text: 检查 Vercel 账号登录是否正常。
say.note: 会运行 vercel whoami 验证令牌。

howto.what_en: After this skill is added, NanoClaw agents can deploy web apps to Vercel. The Vercel CLI gets installed in the container, and an access token is auto-injected, so deployment commands don't need manual credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants agents to deploy web apps to Vercel, or asks to enable Vercel deployment for agents.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs the vercel deploy command for production.
Calls vercel ls to show deployment records.

say_en.text: Check whether the Vercel account is authenticated.
say_en.note: Runs vercel whoami to verify the token.
